description: This file defines a report parser class for generating account balance landscape reports in Odoo, including methods for processing account data, formatting output, and handling fiscal years.

classes.name: account_balance_landscape
classes.description: A report parser class for generating account balance landscape reports, with methods for processing account data, formatting lines, and calculating totals.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context variables and local context functions.

methods.name: linesForYear
methods.description: Prepares year-wise data for the report, formatting totals and year labels.

methods.name: linesForTotal
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit for accounts over fiscal years.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates a list of account lines with balances, including nested child accounts.

methods.name: get_years
methods.description: Retrieves and formats fiscal year labels for the report.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Extracts specific line data for a given year, including balances and patterns.

methods.name: cal_total
methods.description: Sets total debit and credit values for a given year.
